action_summary: Reverted the configuration to the one that produced the best leaderboard score (v15, 0.94396): FOLDS = [0,1,2,3] and CONVERT_TO_RANK = False (rank-averaging has been net negative across the history, and fold 4 lowered the score). Replaced the hard-coded SingleHeadModel instantiation (introduced in v17, which cost ~0.003) with checkpoint-driven model selection: the state dict is loaded first and MultiHeadResNeXt is used unless the checkpoint contains head_fc keys, so the pipeline cannot crash on either weight layout while preferring the better multi-head architecture. Also indexed the prediction array by enumeration position instead of fold_id so non-contiguous fold lists work. Kept image size 448 (512 hurt in v11), no flip TTA because catheter laterality is anatomically asymmetric.
